movers.headline: secures two Uttar Pradesh EPC contracts worth a combined Rs 3,469 cr -- the Jewar Link Expressway (Rs 2,086 cr) and an underground Lucknow Metro Phase-1B stretch (Rs 1,383 cr)

publishes its Public Announcement for a Rs 120 cr tender-offer buyback of up to 24 lakh shares at Rs 500 each (~4.85% of paid-up capital & free reserves), record date 13-Nov
